task: Regression (predicting annual log salary in INR)

training_data.leakage_prevention: Train/test split performed before computing any outlier bounds, category frequencies, or TF-IDF representations

known_limitations: Selection bias: Trained exclusively on ~26% of job postings with disclosed salaries.
Historical baseline: 2019 salary levels do not reflect current inflation or nominal market changes.
User industry/role are unobserved at runtime and defaulted to baseline reference categories.
